title: LIT: Lessons In Typing
description: Learn to touch type, one lesson at a time.
package.lesson_01_about: The keys under the fingers of the left hand, and the space bar.
package.lesson_02_about: The keys under the fingers of the right hand, and the semicolon.
package.lesson_03: LIT 3: Reaching up: E and I
package.lesson_03_about: The first keys off the home row: E and I, with the middle fingers.
package.lesson_04: LIT 4: Reaching up: R and U
package.lesson_04_about: Index fingers up to R and U.
package.review_1: LIT Review #1: Home row and first reaches
package.review_1_about: Lessons 1 to 4 together, with the keyboard hidden: the home row and E, I, R, U.
package.lesson_05: LIT 5: Reaching in: G and H
package.lesson_05_about: Index fingers in to G and H, between the hands.
package.lesson_06: LIT 6: Reaching up: W and O
package.lesson_06_about: Ring fingers up to W and O.
package.lesson_07: LIT 7: Reaching up and in: T and Y
package.lesson_07_about: Index fingers up and in to T and Y.
package.lesson_08: LIT 8: Reaching up: Q and P
package.lesson_08_about: Little fingers up to Q and P: the whole top row of letters.
package.review_2_about: Lessons 1 to 8 together, with the keyboard hidden: the whole top row.
package.lesson_09: LIT 9: Reaching down: V and M
package.lesson_09_about: Index fingers down to V and M: the first bottom-row keys.
package.lesson_10: LIT 10: Reaching down and in: B and N
package.lesson_10_about: Index fingers down and in to B and N.
package.lesson_11: LIT 11: Reaching down: C, X and Z
package.lesson_11_about: The left hand's bottom row: every letter of the alphabet.
package.lesson_12_about: Right middle and ring fingers down to the comma and the period.
package.review_3_about: Lessons 1 to 12 together, with the keyboard hidden: every letter, the comma and the period.
package.lesson_13_about: Capital letters: the Shift key on the other side from the letter, and Caps Lock for whole words.
package.lesson_14_about: Fixing mistakes: change a letter, change a word, and fix every mistake.
package.lesson_15_about: The number row, left hand: 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5.
package.lesson_16_about: The number row, right hand: 6, 7, 8, 9 and 0.
package.review_4_about: Lessons 1 to 16 together, with the keyboard hidden: capitals, numbers and everything so far.

strictNotice: Fix every mistake with Backspace (←) before the next sentence appears.
